item.text:
<linkedin_post>Maintaining AI crawler rules can mean tracking each provider separately. OpenAI has announced support for a shared robots.txt signal that would let website operators communicate the same training preference to multiple participating providers at once.

The signal covers preferences about using website content for foundational generative AI training. OpenAI says it plans to implement it in the coming months, with details to follow. Website operators will also be able to keep using the company’s existing crawler controls.

Participation is voluntary. The reduction in work for publishers will depend on other AI providers honoring the shared signal too.</linkedin_post>
